evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to handle CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR relative path calculations for installed binaries.
rationale: Fixes installation layout breakage on Linux distributions like Arch Linux where non-default libexec directories break the installed wrapper executable. In build, resolving supported-platform and packaging run-time breakage is high priority.
